text:
mira: Quick intake — want to bring up sirocco-8b-chat as a candidate for hosted catalog. Primary ask: throughput/latency sweep across quant modes + ctx lengths so we can pick default serving profile. Details below.

mira: Plan
- run single-request latency and throughput (qps) for seq lens: 512, 1024, 2048, 4096
- batch sizes: 1,2,4,8,16 (prefer continuous batching)
- quant modes: fp16, int8, int4 (if available)
- measure p95/p99, avg, tokens/s, and memory tail
- quality regression quick checks on 50 prompts (sanity)

mira: Suggested bench command:
```
./bench --model sirocco-8b-chat --quant int8 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --iters 300 --warmup 50 --out perf/sirocco/int8_2048_b8.json
```

tom: @mira heads-up: runtime needs kernel for int4 on A100-80GB — I'll check availability. If missing we'll fallback to int8 and mark int4 WIP. :eyes:

lee: For latency SLOs we should capture cold-start vs warm VM vs steady-state. Add: cold start (empty cache), warm (prefill cache), and steady.

mira: Good call. We'll add prefix cache probe: run with 1x50 token prefills and without.

jordan: Prioritization: Hosted customers care most about 1024/2048 range, so weight those higher. Also include a mini A/B with current default model on 50 queries.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist triggered: ensure bench cluster has isolated GPU pool, no noisy neighbors. :white_check_mark:

mira: Quick snippet of initial run (int8, seq=1024, b=8):
```
[run-001] tokens/s: 10240, avg_latency_ms: 52.3, p95: 89.7, mem_used_gb: 42.1
[run-001] note: occasional jitter at 2:34 -> investigate preemption logs
```

tom: I'll add a scheduled run tonight and share artifacts. If int4 kernel appears, we'll add a follow-up.

lee: Add metric to capture kv-cache footprint per seq-length. Also track model size on disk (quantized) and load time.

mira: Action items:
- tom: verify int4 kernel & run perf matrix (assigned)
- lee: add kv-cache logging to bench harness
- jordan: pick 50 eval prompts and bench-quality pass/fail thresholds
- mira: assemble perf dashboard and prioritize 1024/2048 results

tom: noted. Will post links when done. :rocket:

mira: thanks — ping me in thread if any blockers.
